# Purpose
This configuration snippet is from a `.gitattributes` file used in a Git repository. It specifies how Git should handle line endings for files. The `* text=auto` line ensures that Git automatically normalizes line endings for all files, while the `*.sh text eol=lf` line enforces LF (Line Feed) line endings specifically for shell script files with the `.sh` extension.
